question: What is the compound interest (in Rs.) on a sum of Rs. 1,25,000 at 15% per annum for 2 years if the interest is compounded 8-monthly?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal amount = Rs. 1,25,000

Rate = 15% per annum

Time = 2 years

Compounding is done 8-monthly, n = 8

**Concept used:**

Effective rate, R = r% × (n)/(12) per annum

Effective time, T = t × (12)/(n) years

Now, 

Amount = P × (1 + (R)/(100))T 

C.I = Amount - P
